scope: fixed-source offline-entry-only; two-route functional smoke; no six-round full-match playthrough; no old-entry recapture; initial deployment frames only

handoff.verdict: Fixed-source two-route real WebGL2 GPU functional smoke passed. Accept only as a side entry; this is not a quality acceptance, not a full-match acceptance and not acceptance of the three standards.
handoff.firstStep: dot-B first verifies sourceCommit/sourceTree and checks the SHA-256 of every published file against artifact-hashes.json, then publishes the after route as a side entry and confirms the site version it lands on.
doNot: Do not use this run to change the default entry.
Do not treat it as a six-round full match, halftime side switch, end-of-match or play-again, or human visual/feel/audio acceptance.
Do not treat the single initial deployment view as coverage of the wall face/corner, cover sightline, lamp readability, enemy contrast or combat view.
Do not claim cross-task GPU exclusivity or Node 24+ validation.

cleanEvidence.note: The runner asserts a clean worktree before build and re-asserts unchanged HEAD and clean status after both routes, then re-hashes every web-dist file. Only ignored node_modules, dist, web-dist and outputs are outside git status. These checks were made before publishing this evidence directory; the only worktree changes after the run are the new evidence files under docs/quality/smoke/B-FPS-ART-STANDARDS-SMOKE-20261029/.

source.identityCheck: Preflight verified HEAD/tree against base_ref; tools/smoke-backlog.mjs recorded HEAD/tree at start and asserted unchanged HEAD, clean status and unchanged build hashes after capture.

dependencyInstall.note: Offline install from the existing npm cache; EBADENGINE warning because engines.node is >=24 and the host runs Node v22.23.2 (same as the accepted previous run). No network install and no browser download.

smoke.command: FPS_SMOKE_RENDERER=native FPS_SMOKE_CHROMIUM=<existing local Playwright Chromium> node tools/smoke-backlog.mjs --art-standards
smoke.buildLog: npm run build (tsc --noEmit, vite build sim, vite build) completed inside the smoke command
smoke.serial: The two routes ran one after the other: offline-base browser exited at 20:46:48.634Z before the art-standards browser launched at 20:46:49.791Z.

initialFrameComparison.note: Only 0.84% of pixels differ in this single initial deployment view; it may not show the wall face/corner, cover sightline or lamp. Each frame is the fixed runner's #stage element screenshot taken before any page input, so the pre-match deployment menu and HUD overlay are present because the run has not started. It is a reproducible starting frame, not acceptance of the three standards.

cleanup.postRunPortProbe: Ports 4173, 5173, 4174, 5174, 3000, 8080, 8000 and 12765 were confirmed closed after the run.
cleanup.lock: No existing shared GPU mutex or lock file was found or used; no lock was acquired, taken over or released. This is not a claim of cross-task GPU exclusivity.

serialPreflight.otherGpuWork: Before the run: no chrome.exe, chrome-headless-shell.exe or Playwright/Chromium process, no tools/smoke.mjs or Vite preview node process, and no listener on 4173/5173/4174/5174/3000/8080/8000/12765.
serialPreflight.receiverParallelTasks: Separate receiver tasks may be marked running for reader/build work; none owned a browser, preview server or this worktree during preflight.
serialPreflight.singleGpuJob: Exactly one headless Chromium instance at a time, inside the single art-standards smoke command; the two routes were serial, not parallel.
